title: Scenario 3: diagnose an undefined operator with validate_postscript
prompt:
Why doesn't this PostScript work? Check it with the pscat-render tools.

```postscript
%!PS
/Helvetica findfont 24 scalefont setfont
72 700 moveto
(Hello) shw
0 0 1 setrgbcolor
72 600 200 50 rectfill
showpage
```

source.equals_text:
%!PS
/Helvetica findfont 24 scalefont setfont
72 700 moveto
(Hello) shw
0 0 1 setrgbcolor
72 600 200 50 rectfill
showpage

notes: The answer must name the misspelled operator and its fix. It need not repeat the error name or line from validate_postscript's result (#44 triage: two of four HTTP answers said only that `shw` should be `show`).
